responses.analysis: I chose the decide task and my revised request did produce a better answer for the goal than the original request. One specific difference is that I gave the task that the robot needed the tool/object for. Before it was very vague and didn't explicitly say what the tool was for. It also didn't help that the previous requests didn't properly identify the object so the decide just used what it previously "knew" to give its answer. While we know it's a compass that is in the image the robot still needs to be able to identify that. While the tool in the foreground is clear to us it still takes a little more to obtain confidence in the response that is given, and by giving evidence it becomes 10x more helpful. I wouldn't say my request was the best because the response didn't really confirm that the object in the image was a compass but rather that a compass would be the right object for the job in general.
